TEAM COMPUTER SETUP

Install once, then capture automatically

The Chrome extension records participant-generated clicks and page dwell time across the task tab. The app controls session start and stop and stores the returned trace locally.

Install the local trace extension

  1. Open chrome://extensions in Chrome.
  2. Turn on Developer mode.
  3. Choose Load unpacked and select the app’s trace-extension folder.
  4. Refresh this app. “Trace extension connected” should appear before a session starts. If it does not, recording still works as video only.

What the automated trace contains

Captured

Timestamp, page URL/title, active dwell time, click coordinates, safe element label, role, CSS selector, navigation, tab, and viewport.

Excluded

Input values, passwords, clipboard contents, keystrokes, microphone, camera, cookies, network payloads, and pages outside the active study interval.

Why this is not a Playwright trace.zip

Playwright Trace Viewer is designed to inspect actions executed by Playwright automation. A participant’s manual browser clicks are not Playwright actions, so Trace Viewer alone would miss the behavior this study needs. This app uses a consent-based content script to capture real manual clicks and page timing, then presents them in a Trace Viewer-like local timeline alongside the raw recording.
